title: Dili raises $21.7 million to bring AI compliance to the infrastructure boom
summary: We already know that making AI work will mean bringing a lot of new data centers and power infrastructure online . Chaturvedi says Dili’s software is already being used at “about 700 projects,” ranging from manufacturing facilities to data centers.
